jobs.title: Sr. Project Manager, Interconnection Projects & Grid Infrastructure Delivery
jobs.description:
This is a Fully Remote Job

About Our Client:

This organization operates in the energy sector, focusing on delivering affordable and reliable energy solutions to industries, data centers, and the electric grid. It addresses challenges in energy supply by utilizing thermal battery technology that converts low-cost electricity into continuous heat and power, avoiding reliance on constrained critical minerals and lengthy construction times. The company emphasizes mission-driven growth, fostering a diverse and collaborative team dedicated to advancing clean, low-cost energy technologies.

About the Opportunity:

The SR. PROJECT MANAGER, INTERCONNECTION PROJECTS & GRID INFRASTRUCTURE DELIVERY is responsible for overseeing the delivery of interconnection engineering, SCADA and telemetry systems, and grid infrastructure for thermal energy storage projects across multiple regional transmission organizations. This role ensures technical and schedule compliance by managing consultants, engineers, and contractors, directly influencing project execution and advancing the organization’s portfolio within key energy markets.

Responsibilities:

Manage engineering firms through design phases including substations, switchyards, and equipment specifications.
Ensure designs comply with interconnection studies and agreements, addressing changes impacting cost or schedule.
Coordinate utility and transmission owner interactions on network upgrades and facility scopes.
Oversee interfaces with Owner’s Engineers and EPC firms, managing procurement and construction delivery.
Develop and manage statements of work, RFPs, vendor selection, contracts, budgets, and change control.
Maintain vendor management tools such as SOW templates and qualification standards.
Define and manage SCADA, telemetry, and metering engineering scopes and contracts.
Lead innovative measurement approaches and ensure compliance with RTO testing requirements.
Maintain integrated project schedules, track deliverables, and coordinate cross-functional teams.
Communicate project status, risks, and escalations to leadership and stakeholders.

Requirements:

Over 6 years of experience managing capital projects in energy infrastructure including generation, storage, substations, or transmission.
Proficiency in designing and procuring interconnection configurations and coordinating with utilities.
Ability to assess technical documentation for completeness and accuracy.
Experience with SCADA, telemetry, protection and control, or substation automation at utility scale.
Understanding of interconnection studies, agreements, and associated facility construction.
Strong technical writing and project management skills, capable of handling multiple concurrent projects.
Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Salary range: $163,000 USD - $200,000 USD annually.

jobs.title: Project Manager
jobs.description:
Overview

AtkinsRéalis's Minerals and Metals team in Canada is made up of more than 400 employees who work on large-scale projects to support mining sustainability, pit-to-port opportunities, metallurgical plant engineering, or mine closure and capabilities in the study, design, and construction of mining projects across a wide range of mining and processing methods and commodities. The team combines global-caliber expertise to provide tailored solutions for projects of any size, scope, or complexity. We believe in working openly and transparently, together, delivering world-class projects. We work collaboratively with teams across the world, from Canada to Brazil in the south to India in the east, delivering exceptional value and innovation to our clients. To support our growth initiatives, we are expanding our team and are looking for innovative, forward-thinking people who enjoy challenges and want to add value to project success, both locally and internationally.

We are seeking a Project Manager, M&M,
to join our Global Minerals & Metals (M&M) team and to support our growth to align with the demand to supply responsibly sourced critical minerals. The Project Engineer / Project Manager will oversee multidisciplinary teams conducting project studies through detailed design to construction / commissioning. If you are interested in helping to establish and maintain a climate favorable to the application of ethical and professional practices in the execution of project work, this role will be of interest to you.

This opportunity will be to support the growth of our M&M business located in Toronto, Vancouver.

Your role

Lead and manage Conceptual, PFS, FS, FEED, and EPCM studies/projects, including proposal preparation, execution strategy development, project delivery, and management of engineering, procurement, and construction activities in accordance with approved scope, schedule, and performance objectives.
Direct and coordinate multidisciplinary teams, ensuring adequate staffing, effective interdisciplinary collaboration, alignment of deliverables, and strong relationships with clients, vendors, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders.
Develop, monitor, and control project schedules, budgets, forecasts, resource allocations, engineering budgets, and deliverables, using established project management tools to track performance, identify deviations, implement corrective actions, and ensure successful project execution.
Lead technical and engineering activities, including process design, equipment selection, drawing reviews, scope development, engineering and construction execution planning, work package preparation, and acting as Engineering Manager when required.
Oversee the procurement and contracting process, including vendor coordination, preparation and review of requisitions, bids, tender documents, subcontractor identification and prequalification, and ensuring compliance with project scope and technical specifications.
Conduct trade-off studies, risk assessments, and scope management activities, identifying and managing project risks, evaluating alternatives, recommending solutions, and proactively managing scope changes through appropriate change order processes.
Prepare and present project reports, recommendations, forecasts, meeting agendas and minutes, while providing regular stakeholder communications, driving continuous improvement initiatives, and ensuring adherence to project instructions, work processes, and execution methodologies.

About You

Bachelor's degree in Engineering with Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) designation or eligibility for registration in Canada.
Minimum 10 years of progressive project management experience, preferably in EPC/EPCM environments within the mining or heavy industrial sector.
Proven experience in site-based roles or operations within mining process plants or similar industrial settings.
Strong understanding of project management methodologies, cost control, scheduling, and interdisciplinary coordination.
Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to lead virtual and cross-functional teams and maintain strong client relationships.
Self-motivated, results-driven professional with the flexibility to travel (up to 2–3 weeks) and manage complex project environments.

Reward & benefits

Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career at AtkinsRéalis in Canada.

Enjoy competitive compensation, employee recognition, and a brilliant range of flexible benefits you can tailor to your health, wellbeing, financial and lifestyle needs.

Make the most of diverse opportunities for training and professional development to grow your skills and expertise.

And take advantage of our hybrid working culture and generous time-off policies to balance a fulfilling career with your personal life.

Be rewarded. Find out more.

About AtkinsRéalis

We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's'infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people.

Find out more.

Please consult our Privacy Notice on our Careers site to know more about how we collect, use, and transfer your Personal Data.

By submitting your personal information to AtkinsRéalis, you confirm that you have read and accept our Privacy Notice.

Appropriate accommodations will be provided upon request throughout the recruitment and hiring process as required by Company policy and the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA).

Successful applicants will be notified about AtkinsRéalis' accommodation policies at the time the employment offer is extended, and the information will be shared with new personnel during the onboarding process.

jobs.title: Program Manager, Value and Digital Enterprise
jobs.description:
Who is Taco Bell?

Taco Bell was born and raised in California and has been around since 1962. We went from selling everyone’s favorite Crunchy Tacos on the West Coast to a global brand with 7,500+ restaurants, 350 franchise organizations, that serve 42+ million fans each week around the globe. We’re not only the largest Mexican-inspired quick service brand (QSR) in the world, we’re also part of the biggest restaurant group in the world: Yum! Brands.

Much of our fan love and authentic connection with our communities are rooted in being rebels with a cause. From ensuring we use high quality, sustainable ingredients to elevating restaurant technology in ways that hasn’t been done before… we will continue to be inclusive, bold, challenge the status quo and push industry boundaries.

We’re a company that celebrates and advocates for different, has bold self-expression, strives for a better future, and brings the fun while we’re at it. We fuel our culture with real people who bring unique experiences. We inspire and enable our teams and the world to Live Más.

At Taco Bell, we’re Cultural Rebels. Want to join in on the passion-fueled fun? Learn more about the career below.

About The Job

The Program Manager, Value & Digital Enterprise is a strategic leadership role within Taco Bell’s Enterprise Operations & Program Management team. This role leads the integrated Value, Digital Integration, and Loyalty portfolios, translating business strategy into coordinated cross-functional plans that deliver current-year commitments while building the future pipeline.

The Program Manager provides senior program leadership across multiple interconnected portfolios, leading through ambiguity, aligning priorities across functions, surfacing risks and trade-offs early, and ensuring leaders have the visibility and recommendations required to make timely decisions. The role partners closely with category and enterprise Team Leads and works across Marketing, Digital & Technology, Product, FIT, Operations, Finance, Insights, and other cross-functional teams to connect strategy, planning, and execution through Taco Bell’s 3Ds Enterprise System.

This role also leads and develops two L8 Associate Program Managers, allocating program-management capacity based on business complexity, risk, and priority while building a high-performing program-management capability. Success requires a leader who can operate at both Speed 1, delivering today’s commitments, and Speed 2, planning and enabling tomorrow’s growth.

The Day-to-Day

Value Portfolio Leadership

Partner with the Value Team Lead to translate Value strategy into an integrated current- and future-year roadmap across testing, national launches, and pipeline development.
Lead program management across the Value portfolio, connecting initiatives through Discover, Design, and Deploy and ensuring cross-functional readiness for key business milestones.
Identify sequencing, resource, timing, and cross-functional dependencies early; develop scenarios and recommended paths when priorities, scope, or capacity conflict.
Provide leadership visibility into portfolio health, critical milestones, decisions, risks, and readiness, ensuring issues are surfaced at the right time and level.

Digital Integration & Loyalty Leadership

Lead integrated planning across Digital Integration and Loyalty, connecting initiatives to the broader Marketing calendar, enterprise priorities, and enabling technology and operational roadmaps.
Align business objectives and cross-functional roadmaps across Marketing, Digital & Technology, Operations, FIT, Finance, Product, and other partners to ensure coordinated delivery.
Anticipate enterprise dependencies and readiness risks that could impact customer experience, launch timing, or business outcomes and establish mitigation plans before issues become execution barriers.
Create clear governance and leadership visibility for complex initiatives requiring sustained cross-functional coordination and decision support.

Strategic Program & Portfolio Leadership

Set the program-management approach, governance, and operating rhythm across the assigned portfolio, ensuring consistency in planning, risk management, escalation, and decision-making.
Recommend sequencing, resource, timeline, and scope trade-offs to Team Leads and senior leadership based on business impact, risk, dependencies, and capacity.
Determine which issues should be resolved within the working team versus escalated to enterprise leadership, bringing forward clear recommendations and decision options.
Use portfolio insights to identify recurring risks, bottlenecks, or capacity constraints and partner with Enterprise Operations and Portfolio Management to improve how the work is planned and governed.

People & Capability Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop two L8 Associate Program Managers, establishing clear ownership, performance expectations, and development priorities.
Allocate program-management capacity across the portfolio based on complexity, risk, business priority, and developmental opportunity.
Review program and portfolio health across direct reports, redirecting resources and escalating trade-offs when capacity or complexity exceeds the support model.
Build strategic program-management capability across the team by strengthening judgment, executive communication, enterprise thinking, risk management, and influence without authority.

Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership

Serve as a strategic thought partner to Value, Digital Integration, and Loyalty leaders, helping translate strategy into executable plans and surfacing decisions needed to maintain momentum.
Lead high-stakes cross-functional discussions where ambiguity, competing priorities, or dependencies require alignment across teams and functions.
Create concise, decision-oriented leadership communications that provide a clear view of portfolio health, risks, trade-offs, and recommended actions.
Champion Taco Bell’s enterprise ways of working and 3Ds disciplines within the portfolio while partnering with Enterprise Operations on broader process and operating-model improvements.

Is this you?

7–10+ years of progressive program/project management, business operations, marketing operations, digital, loyalty, or comparable cross-functional leadership experience.
BA/BS degree or equivalent relevant experience. MBA or advanced degree a plus.
Demonstrated experience leading multiple complex programs or portfolios with significant cross-functional dependencies and executive visibility.
People leadership experience, including coaching, delegation, performance management, and development of program/project management talent.
Strong program-management expertise across integrated planning, risk management, governance, prioritization, issue resolution, and executive communication.
Experience with Monday.com and other portfolio management solutions.
Demonstrated ability to influence decisions, resolve ambiguity, and drive alignment across senior cross-functional stakeholders.
Strong business acumen and ability to connect program decisions to customer, operational, financial, and strategic outcomes.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear decisions and recommendations.
Experience within Marketing, Digital, Loyalty, consumer products, QSR, restaurant, retail, or similarly complex matrixed environments.
Experience with enterprise operating models, portfolio management, change management, or organizational effectiveness methodologies.
Experience leading work through stage-gate, product-development, test-and-learn, commercialization, or national launch processes.

Work-Hard, Play-Hard

Hybrid work schedule (onsite expectation Tues, Wed, Thurs) and year-round flex day Friday
Onsite childcare through Bright Horizons
Onsite dining center and game room (yes, there is a Taco Bell inside the building)
Onsite dry cleaning, laundry services, and carwash
Onsite gym with fitness classes and personal trainer sessions
Up to 4 weeks of vacation per year plus holidays and time off for volunteering
Generous parental leave for all new parents and adoption assistance program
401(k) with a 6% matching contribution from Yum! Brands with immediate vesting
Comprehensive medical & dental including prescription drug benefits and 100% preventive care
Discounts, free food, swag and… honestly, too many good benefits to name

Salary Range: ­­$137,900 to $162,300 annually + bonus eligibility + benefits

The above represents the expected salary range for this job requisition. Ultimately, in determining your pay, we'll consider your location, experience, and other job-related factors.

You will oversee multiple client engagements while balancing support commitments, project delivery, resources, budgets, and timelines. The position offers the opportunity to lead strategic technology initiatives with significant business and executive visibility. Housing Case Managers (1); Program Assistants

ESSENTIAL DUTIES And RESPONSIBILITIES

Team Management and Development:

Provide regular, weekly supervision to safe house staff and develop individual performance objectives and conduct twice annual evaluations.
Supervise program staff in client interactions and program service delivery including crisis situations.
Recruit, hire, orient and train safe house staff.
Work with safe house staff and with the Director of Programs to identify staff training/development needs.
Facilitate weekly safe house team meetings.
Coordinate safe house staff scheduling to ensure appropriate and necessary site coverage.
Coordinate with HR to ensure staff compliance with agency policies, accurate time recording, benefits usage, etc.

Program Management And Development

RINA is a global knowledge company where expertise travels across borders, disciplines, and industries. Every day, we collaborate on solving complex challenges that no single field could tackle alone. With a presence in more than 70 countries and 160 years of heritage, we turn individual know-how into collective progress.

Foreship (part of RINA) is currently recruiting for a Technical Project Manager
to join our office in Helsinki/Turku/Hamburg
within the Europe Marine Engineering
Division.

Mission

The Project Manager is responsible for leading and delivering complex cruise ship conversion projects, ensuringtechnical excellence, regulatory compliance, budget control, and client satisfaction. The role also contributes tonewbuilding and technology-driven projects, acting as a key link between clients, design teams, and internalstakeholders to ensure successful project execution from concept development through delivery. #FORESHIP

Key Accountabilities

Lead and manage large, complex cruise ship conversion projects from early design phase through to final delivery.
Contribute as a key Project Manager in cruise ship newbuilding and ferry projects when required.
Actively participate in demanding ship design projects, primarily related to cruise ship conversions, in close collaboration with the Naval Architecture Engineering Department.
Contribute to the technical design by preparing drawings, documents and reports for client projects.
Support additional projects, including cruise ship newbuilding, ferry newbuilding, and new technologyinitiatives, as needed.
Define and manage project scope, objectives, timelines, and resource planning in alignment with clientexpectations and internal requirements.
Monitor and control project budget, schedule, risks, and quality throughout the full project lifecycle.
Coordinate multidisciplinary teams, including naval architects, engineers, and external partners, ensuringefficient collaboration and delivery.
Provide technical oversight and expertise in: general arrangement, technical specifications, classificationsociety rules and maritime regulations, safety and statutory requirements.
Represent the company in client meetings, technical workshops, and design reviews, providing expertguidance and practical solutions.

Qualifications

M.Sc. or B.Sc. in Naval Architecture, Marine Engineering, or a related discipline.
Minimum 5 years of experience in relevant role (Project Engineer/Project Manager or similar) for cruise ship conversion projects and/or newbuildingprojects.
Proven track record of managing large-scale maritime projects with full responsibility for scope, budget, andschedule.
Strong technical knowledge of ship design processes, particularly within cruise vessel conversion projects.
Solid understanding of general arrangement, ship systems integration, technical specifications withincomplex cruise ship projects.
Strong knowledge of maritime rules, regulations, and class requirements, with hands-on experience applyingthem during conversions.
Ability to confidently lead client meetings and technical discussions.
Fluency in English, both written and spoken.
Strong organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage priorities undertight schedules.
Ability to manage multiple complex projects simultaneously in a dynamic environment.

Competencies

WORKPLACE DYNAMICS - Resourcefulness in shaping progress and working efficiently.
PERSONAL EMPOWERMENT - Ownership for life, work and results, striving to grow professionally and personally.
INTERPERSONAL INFLUENCE - Skills and strategies we use to interact effectively with others.
DOMAIN & BUSINESS ACUMEN - Applying a scientific approach and critical thinking in operations and solution development within area of expertise.
FORESIGHT & INSIGHT - Context awareness adopting a systemic perspective and informed decision making.

At RINA, your growth drives our innovation. We bring together engineers, inspectors, digital minds and specialists from more than 100 nationalities, creating an environment where diverse perspectives sharpen how we think, collaborate and deliver.

Flexibility and respect drive how we work. We are committed to building a workplace where every person feels valued and empowered to develop their potential. RINA provides equal employment opportunities and does not discriminate on any basis. We are compliant with Italian Law n. 68/99.

Stellenbeschreibung

Für den Bereich „Cyber Security“ suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen „Cyber Security Program Manager (w/m/d)“ am Standort Ulm (bevorzugt) Fürstenfeldbruck, Taufkirchen, Immenstaad, Oberkochen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Der Bereich Cyber Security verantwortet die Weiterentwicklung der unternehmensweiten Cyber-Security-Strategie und den Schutz der IT-Landschaft von HENSOLDT. Im Rahmen eines langfristig angelegten Zero-Trust-Programms werden Sicherheitsarchitekturen und -maßnahmen über mehrere Domänen der Inhouse IT hinweg weiterentwickelt. Der Cyber Security Program Manager koordiniert dabei die übergreifende Ausrichtung des Programms und arbeitet mit rund 50 Beteiligten und Key Usern aus sieben IT-Domänen zusammen.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören

Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung des unternehmensweiten Zero-Trust-Programms über sieben Domänen der Inhouse IT hinweg
Weiterentwicklung der Programm-Roadmap sowie Koordination und Abstimmung der Zero-Trust-Initiativen und Abhängigkeiten zwischen den beteiligten IT-Domänen
Fachliche Bewertung und Einordnung moderner Cyber-Security-Technologien und Sicherheitsmaßnahmen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Endpoint Protection, Netzwerk- und Firewall-Sicherheit sowie Angriffserkennung
Koordination der beteiligten Key User sowie zentraler technischer und fachlicher Stakeholder innerhalb der IT-Organisation
Sicherstellung einer übergreifend abgestimmten Umsetzung der Zero-Trust-Zielsetzung sowie Identifikation und Steuerung von Schnittstellen, Abhängigkeiten und Handlungsbedarfen
Vorbereitung und Moderation von Entscheidungsformaten sowie transparente Kommunikation von Programmfortschritt, Risiken und wesentlichen technischen Fragestellungen

Das bringst du mit

Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Cyber Security sowie nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Umsetzung oder Steuerung von Cyber-Security-Projekten
Fundierte Kenntnisse aktueller Cyber-Security-Technologien und Sicherheitsarchitekturen sowie praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einem relevanten Security-Umfeld, beispielsweise Endpoint Protection, Firewall-Sicherheit oder moderner Angriffserkennung
Erfahrung in der Koordination komplexer technischer Vorhaben sowie im Stakeholder Management über unterschiedliche IT-Bereiche hinweg
Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise in komplexen technischen Umfeldern
Bereitschaft zur Durchführung einer Sicherheitsüberprüfung
Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

jetzt bewerben

Über das Unternehmen

HENSOLDT ist ein führendes europäisches Hightech-Unternehmen der Verteidigungs- und Sicherheitsindustrie mit Sitz in Taufkirchen bei München. Das Unternehmen entwickelt Sensorlösungen, Elektronik und Software für die Bereiche Luft, Land, See, Cyber und Weltraum und unterstützt Streitkräfte weltweit dabei, Bedrohungen frühzeitig zu erkennen und fundierte operative Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Aufbauend auf jahrzehntelanger Erfahrung in missionskritischer Sensorik verbindet HENSOLDT Radar-, Optronik-, Elektronik- und Cyberkompetenzen mit datengetriebener Software und künstlicher Intelligenz.

Ziel ist es, Sensordaten aus unterschiedlichen Plattformen und Domänen zu integrieren, zu analysieren und zu einem verlässlichen Lagebild zu fusionieren.

Im Geschäftsjahr 2025 erzielte HENSOLDT mit rund 9.500 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern einen Umsatz von 2,46 Milliarden Euro. Das Unternehmen ist an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im MDAX notiert.

jobs.description:
Notre client, actif dans le secteur chimique à Liège, est à la recherche d'un Project Manager Officer - Engineering.
Ce poste vous offre l'opportunité unique d'animer une équipe de chefs de projet tout en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les disciplines électriques, mécaniques, automatisation et génie civil. Vous serez au cœur de l'excellence opérationnelle, dans un environnement où la réussite collective est valorisée et où chaque membre contribue activement à l'amélioration continue.

Vos responsabilités en tant que Project Manager Officer - Engineering:

Superviser la planification, l'exécution et le suivi des projets afin d'assurer l'atteinte des objectifs fixés dans le respect des délais, des coûts et de la qualité attendue.
Encadrer, accompagner et motiver une équipe de chefs de projet en favorisant la collaboration, le développement des compétences et l'amélioration continue.
Analyser les processus existants et proposer des actions d'amélioration, tout en mettant en œuvre les retours d'expérience nécessaires à l'évolution des standards.
Gérer le portefeuille CAPEX en assurant la priorisation des projets, les arbitrages, l'allocation optimale des ressources, ainsi que la consolidation des indicateurs et le reporting à la Direction.
Définir et déployer des indicateurs de performance (KPI) permettant de mesurer efficacement l'efficacité des projets et celle des équipes.
Identifier et évaluer les risques liés aux projets puis élaborer et suivre les plans d'actions nécessaires à leur maîtrise.
Assurer une communication fluide et transparente entre les équipes projets, les opérations et la Direction afin de garantir une bonne circulation de l'information.
Favoriser un climat collaboratif entre toutes les disciplines techniques impliquées (électrique, mécanique, automation, génie civil) pour maximiser la réussite collective.

Le profil idéal que nous recherchons:

Diplôme d'Ingénieur industriel ou civil avec orientation chimie ou procédés ou équivalent reconnu par le secteur.
Expérience confirmée d'au moins 7 ans en tant que PMO ou dans une fonction similaire avec une solide expérience en management d'équipe, coaching et développement des talents.
Certification en gestion de projet (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile ou équivalent) indispensable; une certification Green Belt ou Black Belt Lean Six Sigma constitue un atout supplémentaire appréciable.
Excellent niveau de français et de l'anglais (lu, écrit, parlé).

Ce que notre client vous offre:

Notre client est un chef de file renommé de l'industrie, connu pour son engagement envers l'innovation, la qualité et l'excellence.
Ils offrent un environnement de travail dynamique qui favorise la créativité et encourage l'épanouissement professionnel.
L'accent mis sur l'amélioration continue et les progrès technologiques les distingue de leurs concurrents.

Si vous vous considérez comme un spécialiste flexible de la résolution de problèmes avec votre sens analytique, doté de solides compétences d'amélioration et d'innovation, et prêt à faire face à des conditions difficiles, le poste du Project Manager Engineering est fait pour vous. N'hésitez pas à nous faire parvenir votre CV.

jobs.description:
組織について

AI & Technology Modernization BUでは、AI Transformation（AITM）として、デジタル変革を推進しています。領域横断で連携し、構想から実装、定着までを一気通貫で支援します。我々は、下記の8つの領域でコンサルティングを行っています。

１．デジタルサービスデザイン

２．先端テクノロジー目利き

３．エンタープライズアーキテクチャデザイン

４．AI

５．データマネジメント・ガバナンス

６. デジタル・インプリメンテーション

７. ビジネスレジリエンス

８. デジタルケイパビリティ醸成

本求人では「４．AI」を推進いただくメンバーを募集しています。

このポジションでは、経営・事業・業務課題を起点に、AI活用の価値仮説、将来業務、KPI、投資優先順位を具体化します。AI実装担当と構想段階から協働し、実現可能性を踏まえたロードマップを策定。顧客の意思決定を支援するとともに、業務への定着、組織能力の整備、導入後の成果検証・改善を主導します。

入社後のアサイン想定プロジェクト

顧客の経営・事業・業務課題を起点に、AIを活用した変革テーマの探索、ユースケース企画、実行ロードマップ策定から導入・定着までを一気通貫で支援します。経営層、事業部門、IT部門、データ／AI専門家をつなぎ、AIを単発の実証実験で終わらせず、業務やサービスに組み込み、継続的な事業成果へつなげることがミッションです。

【プロジェクト例】

①AI変革テーマの構想・企画

経営戦略や事業課題を踏まえてAI活用機会を探索し、顧客価値、実現可能性、リスク、投資対効果の観点から優先ユースケースを具体化します。

② AI変革ロードマップと実行推進

目指す業務・サービス像、KPI、推進体制、データ・システム上の論点を整理し、ロードマップを策定。経営層、業務部門、IT部門、専門家の合意形成を主導し、PoCから導入、定着、効果検証まで伴走します。

配属先想定

AI & Technology Modernization BU

AI Native Enterprise Strategy Sector

Strategy Group

求める人材像

＜BUで求める人物像＞

変化するビジネス環境と最新テクノロジーを貪欲に吸収し、チームの多様性を活かしながら課題解決に執着できる方
クライアントやパートナーと協働し、構想止まりではなく実現まで責任を持てる方
前例のない課題にも、自分なりの解を考え抜き、行動できる方
新しい技術を「新しいから」ではなく、本質的なインパクト・価値で評価できる方
社内外の多様なステークホルダーを巻き込み、当事者意識を持ってプロジェクトを推進できる方
グローバル規模でクライアント課題の解決に取り組みたい方
クライアントと共創し、共に成長していきたい方
論理思考と柔軟な発想力を持ち、チャレンジを楽しめる方
目標達成への強いコミットメントをお持ちの方
クラウド／セキュリティ等のモダンテクノロジーを積極的に習得する好奇心・向上心をお持ちの方

＜募集ポジションで求める人物像＞

AIを技術導入ではなく、事業成長や業務変革を実現する経営・事業アジェンダとして捉えられる方
顧客の曖昧な経営・業務課題を構造化し、AI活用テーマ、目指す姿、KPI、実行計画へ落とし込める方
経営層、事業部門、IT部門、データ／AI専門家など、多様な関係者との議論を通じ、意思決定と変革を前進させられる方
PoCの実施をゴールとせず、業務への定着、組織能力の向上、事業成果の創出まで粘り強く推進できる方

経験業種

経験業種不問（社会人実務経験2年以上）

戦略・業務コンサルタント、事業企画、DX／AI推進、プロダクト企画、サービスデザインなどの経験者を幅広く想定します。

経験業務-必須要件

＜BUの必須要件＞

デジタルテクノロジーに関連する業務経験3年以上
システム開発／ITインフラ／セキュリティ／クラウド／AIに関する基本的な知識・経験（または同等の知識・経験）
クラウド技術（AWS／Azure／GCP等）を活用したシステム設計・開発・構築・運用のいずれかの経験
IT戦略／企画／構築／運用保守などのITライフサイクルに関わる実務経験3年以上

＜募集ポジションの必須要件＞

経営・事業・業務課題を整理し、デジタル／AIを活用した変革構想、施策、ロードマップの策定を推進した経験（3年以上、または同等の知識・経験）

経験業務-歓迎要件

＜BUの歓迎要件＞

英語力（グローバルプロジェクトへの参画等、キャリアの可能性が広がります）
プロジェクト責任者として顧客協働をリードした経験、またはプロダクトマネジメント業務経験（3年以上）
コンサルティング業務経験（3年以上）※SIer／シンクタンクでのご経験も可
大企業のCxOレベルへの提案経験

＜募集ポジションの歓迎要件＞

全社または事業部門におけるAI戦略、DX戦略、AI活用ロードマップ、AIガバナンスの策定・推進経験
生成AI/データ活用のユースケース探索、評価、優先順位付け、PoC企画の経験
業務プロセスや顧客体験を可視化し、AI活用を前提とした将来像や業務改革案を設計した経験
クライアント側の経営層、事業部門、IT部門、外部パートナー等を巻き込み、論点整理、合意形成、プロジェクト推進を行った経験
仮説検証、ユーザーリサーチ、ワークショップ等を通じて、施策やサービスの価値を検証・改善した経験
事業KPI、業務KPI、投資対効果を設計し、データに基づいて施策の効果検証と改善を行った経験
AI活用を継続的に推進するための組織、役割、会議体、人材育成、ガイドライン等の仕組みを整備した経験

歓迎資格/スキル

＜BUで歓迎する資格/スキル＞

jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
About Retell Ai

Retell AI is using first-principles thinking to reimagine the call center with cutting-edge voice AI. Thousands of companies now use Retell's AI voice agents to handle sales, support, and logistics calls that once required large teams of human agents. Backed by Y Combinator, Alt Capital, and other leading investors, we've scaled to $80M in ARR with a team of 50, up from $5M at the start of 2025, and are now valued at over $1.5B.

Our vision for 2026 is to build a modern CX platform where entire contact centers are powered by AI. Instead of basic automation that needs constant human tuning, we're creating intelligent AI “workers” that act as frontline agents, QA analysts, and managers, continuously executing, monitoring, and improving every customer interaction.

We're growing fast and looking for ambitious builders who want to tackle hard technical problems, move quickly, and have a real impact on one of the fastest-growing voice AI companies in the world.

Let's build the future together.

Recent Recognition

No. 1 Best Places to Work in the Bay Area, San Francisco Business Times 2026
Top 50 AI Apps, a16z (2025)
#3 Fastest-Growing Software Company, G2 Best Software Awards 2026
Best Agentic AI Software, G2 Best Software Awards 2026
#4 Fastest-Growing Software Vendor, Brex Benchmark 2025
Enterprise Tech 30 Class of 2026, Nasdaq & Wing VC
Top-Ranked Startup, Lean AI Leaderboard
Backed by Y Combinator

About The Role

Retell AI transforms customer experience with voice AI for enterprises, including customers like CVS/Aetna, American Airlines, Lenovo, and Grab. We have more customer stories than we can tell!

This is a highly strategic, customer-facing role for operators who thrive at the intersection of technology, product, and execution.

As a Deployment Strategist at Retell, you will work directly with some of the most innovative companies deploying AI-powered voice agents. You will lead implementations from initial discovery through production launch, helping customers redesign business processes around AI while ensuring successful technical delivery.

You will serve as a trusted advisor to executives, operators, and technical teams, helping customers define requirements, scope solutions, drive adoption, and realize measurable business outcomes. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Customer Success while helping shape the future of how enterprises deploy voice AI.

If you enjoy solving ambiguous problems, working directly with customers, and owning outcomes from strategy through execution, this role offers an opportunity to operate at the center of one of the fastest-growing categories in AI.

Key Responsibilities

Lead end-to-end customer deployments from discovery through production launch, owning project execution, stakeholder communication, risk management, and successful delivery.
Partner directly with customers to understand business goals, gather requirements, and translate them into scalable AI-powered workflows.
Become a subject matter expert in Retell's platform, voice AI best practices, and LLM prompting techniques.
Design conversational workflows, automation strategies, and deployment architectures that deliver measurable business outcomes.
Build prototypes, validate use cases, and guide customers through implementation tradeoffs and optimization opportunities.
Act as a trusted advisor to executives and operational leaders, helping them identify opportunities to leverage AI across their organizations.
Lead discovery sessions, business process reviews, and strategic planning conversations with customer stakeholders.
Build ROI models and business cases that quantify the impact of AI automation and help customers prioritize initiatives.
Partner closely with Sales during pre-sales engagements, solution scoping, and customer presentations.
Coordinate across Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to unblock deployments and ensure customer success.
Communicate project progress, risks, recommendations, and next steps clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Translate customer feedback into actionable product recommendations and help shape the future direction of the Retell platform.
Develop repeatable deployment playbooks, best practices, and frameworks that enable customers to deploy voice AI successfully at scale.

YOU MIGHT THRIVE IF YOU

Have exceptional communication skills and can quickly build credibility with executives, operators, and technical teams.
Enjoy acting as a trusted advisor and influencing decisions across multiple stakeholders.
Have strong product intuition and enjoy understanding customer workflows, identifying pain points, and designing scalable solutions.
Can balance technical implementation details with business outcomes and strategic thinking.
Thrive in ambiguous environments and enjoy creating structure where none exists.
Have a strong ownership mentality and are willing to do whatever is necessary to drive successful outcomes.
Enjoy managing complex projects with multiple stakeholders and competing priorities.
Are highly organized, execution-oriented, and able to move initiatives from concept to production.
Have experience in deployment, implementation, solutions consulting, product management, forward deployed engineering, strategic consulting, or other customer-facing technology roles.
Have experience writing requirements, implementation plans, PRDs, or project specifications.
Have experience building business cases, performing ROI analysis, or conducting value-based solution scoping.
Are excited about AI, LLMs, voice technology, and helping customers adopt cutting-edge technologies.
Enjoy learning new systems, becoming a domain expert, and solving difficult customer problems.
Are comfortable navigating technical conversations even if you are not a full-time engineer.
Want to operate at the intersection of technology, product, strategy, and customer success at one of the fastest-growing AI companies.

JOB DETAILS

Cash: 170k - 260k
Equity: Equity Provided
Location: Redwood City, CA, US - relocation provided
US Visas: Retell AI is open to sponsoring work authorization for qualified candidates, including H1B/H-1B, TN, L-1, E-3, F-1 (OPT/CPT).

Other Benefits

100% coverage for medical, dental, and vision insurance
$70/day DoorDash credit for unlimited breakfast, lunch, dinner, and snacks
$200/month wellness reimbursement (gym, fitness classes, etc.)
$300/month commuter reimbursement (gas, Caltrain, etc.)
$75/month phone bill reimbursement
$50/month internet reimbursement

Compensation Philosophy

Best Offer Upfront: Choose from three cash-equity balance options; no negotiation needed.
Top 1% Talent: Above-market pay (top 5 percentile) to attract exceptional builders.
High Ownership: Small teams, >$1M revenue/employee, and significant equity.
Performance-Based: Offers tied to interview performance, not experience or past salaries.

INTERVIEW PROCESS

Talent Screen (15 min): An introductory conversation with our recruiting team to learn more about your background, experience, and interest in Retell.
Functional Interview (45 min): A practical discussion focused on problem-solving, communication, customer-facing judgment, and how you approach ambiguous business and technical challenges.
Hiring Manager Interview (30 min): A conversation focused on past experiences, ownership, stakeholder management, and working in high-growth environments.
Final Interviews (3 hrs): A series of collaborative interviews with members of our Product, Engineering, and GTM teams. We'll explore how you think through customer problems, work cross-functionally, communicate with stakeholders, and execute in fast-paced environments.

Partner with business units, customer-facing teams, architects, engineers, and operations to define scope, outcomes, assumptions, dependencies, and acceptance criteria

2+ year of experience supporting or managing technology or infrastructure projects, with hands-on delivery exposure in at least one of these areas: data centres, servers or storage, networks, cloud platforms, or GPU/AI infrastructure
Sound project management fundamentals, including schedule and dependency management, risk and change control, vendor coordination, and acceptance or handover planning
Ability to work across technical and non-technical teams, understand delivery dependencies, and coordinate contributors without direct line-management authority
Clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment, and the ability to explain project status and trade-offs to internal and external stakeholders

jobs.title: Research Analyst (All Genders)
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

STARK is a new kind of defence technology company revolutionising the way autonomous systems are deployed across multiple domains. We design, develop, and manufacture high-performance unmanned systems that are software-defined, mass-scalable, and cost-effective — providing operators with a decisive edge in contested environments.
We are focused on delivering deployable, high-performance systems — not future promises. In a time of rising threats, STARK is bolstering the technological edge of NATO Allies and their Partners to deter aggression and defend Europe, today.

YOUR MISSION

The Research Analyst (All Genders)
produces open-source intelligence on military capabilities, defence markets and competitors. The role suits a recent graduate with think-tank or comparable research experience who wants to apply OSINT and data-collection skills to live commercial and operational questions.

This is a remote position
to be based in one of following countries: United Kingdom
, Germany
, or Ukraine
.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Research and analysis

Research military systems, programmes and force developments, with a focus on unmanned and autonomous systems and the war in Ukraine.
Build and maintain structured registers of competitors, products and capabilities, with sources and confidence levels recorded for each entry.
Produce market assessments covering vendors, programme status, contract awards and likely procurement outcomes.
Write concise briefs and answer ad hoc requests from leadership, product and business development.

Open-source collection

Collect and verify information from official, commercial, media and social media sources, including Russian- and Ukrainian-language material.
Collect and triage imagery and video from Telegram and other platforms; geolocate, chronolocate and identify equipment where relevant.
Build and run scrapers and scheduled collection scripts for company data and social media channels.

Data and tooling

Clean, structure and store collected data so it is searchable and reusable.
Maintain provenance: record where each item came from, when it was collected, and how it was verified.
Contribute to the team's internal tools, dashboards and collection workflows.

WHAT YOU BRING

Required

A degree in war studies, international relations, security studies or a related field. A master's degree or hands-on experience, such as military service, is an advantage.
Research experience at a think tank, research institute, OSINT organisation or comparable body, including internships.
Advanced open-source research skills: search techniques, source evaluation, verification, geolocation and imagery analysis.
A working knowledge of military equipment, force structure and the war in Ukraine.
Experience of market or industry analysis, such as mapping vendors, programmes or contracts.
Clear, concise written English.
Sound judgement on operational security and research ethics.
Eligibility to work in the UK, Germany, or Ukraine.

Nice to Have

Working knowledge of Germany, Ukrainian and/or Russian.
Data collection skills: scraping websites, procurement portals and Telegram channels using Python or similar tools.
Data handling with Python (pandas), SQL or spreadsheets at an advanced level.
Familiarity with procurement data sources
Published analysis, such as reports, articles or investigations.

SECURITY CLEARANCE

Due to the nature of our work in the defence sector, candidates must be eligible to obtain and maintain the appropriate security clearance required for this position. Details will be provided during the recruitment process.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

We are an equal-opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, national origin, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Send your CV in English to apply. We will be in touch shortly.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
JOIN US!

DATA ANALYST

ABOUT LHV

We're building a bank the world actually needs – modern, sharp and genuinely human. We started in Estonia, growing through grit and high standards. Now we're taking on the UK and Europe. The next chapter is about doing the most ambitious work we've ever done, and changing how people experience money.
We run on three values: No Bullshit, Agile, and Never Satisfied. They're not wall art. They're how we make decisions, push each other and show up every day.

WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

We're building the financial crime controls of the future, and they need to scale with every customer and product LHV takes on. This is a chance to build that foundation from the ground up, together with the team. We don't just maintain what exists. We grow it and challenge it.

You'll help drive data and analytics work across our Anti-Financial Crime (AFC) domain. You'll take projects from opportunity to delivery and help scale the team through automation and self-service tooling.

You'll help build a trusted, scalable data foundation for AML monitoring, screening and customer risk assessment. You'll improve data quality, keep metrics consistent and make insights easier to reach. That removes manual bottlenecks and helps us detect financial crime faster and more accurately. It also lets us show regulators, clearly and with evidence, that our controls work.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

You'll work alongside AFC analysts, investigators and engineers, contributing to:

Analysing and optimising transaction monitoring and screening performance, and proposing changes backed by data.
Customer risk assessment, through analysis of risk factors and the impact of model changes.
Building and maintaining AFC dashboards and management reporting.
Defining and documenting metric logic, business definitions and dataset contracts for AFC data.
Automating recurring manual analyses and data pulls so AFC teams can self-serve.
Working with Anti-Financial Crime teams, including monitoring and screening teams, 2nd line compliance, data engineering and AI teams, on data-driven improvements to our financial crime controls.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

4+ years of experience as a data analyst or in a similar role.
Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
SQL/Python proficiency and familiarity with BI tools (preferably Tableau).
Experience with AML, fraud, compliance or other risk analytics is a strong plus.
Curiosity, ownership, and a proactive attitude.
Clear communication skills, and the ability to translate between business or regulatory questions and data reality.
Experience working with AWS and Snowflake is a plus.
Proficiency in Estonian language is preferred.
You already reside in Estonia as we don't offer relocation for this role.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE

Build financial crime controls that scale with LHV's growth, and that last long after you've moved on.
Shape the setup from the start: we don't just maintain, we grow and challenge.
Work with ambitious colleagues who value innovation and move fast.
Enjoy the freedom to experiment and the ownership to build real impact.
Grow professionally and personally through meaningful opportunities.

THE FUTURE WE'RE BUILDING

Banking has been ugly, slow and impersonal for too long. We're fixing that with solutions that respect people's intelligence and technology that actually works for them.
If that sounds like the kind of problem worth working on, let's talk.

JOB LOCATION

Tallinn

pilleriine.alter@lhv.ee

S Rating und Risikosysteme GmbH is a leading provider of risk management solutions within the Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe. As the central service provider, we specialize in delivering standardized procedures and innovative tools for risk measurement, risk control, regulatory banking management, and data analytics. Our mission is to support financial institutions by offering reliable, efficient, and scalable solutions that enhance their risk management capabilities and regulatory compliance. With a dedicated team and a collaborative approach, we strive to be at the forefront of technological advancements in the financial sector, ensuring our clients are well-equipped to navigate the complexities of modern banking.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Risk Management Specialist to join our dynamic team at S Rating und Risikosysteme GmbH. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, implementing, and maintaining advanced risk management solutions tailored to the needs of our clients within the Sparkassen-Finanzgruppe. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including data analysts, software developers, and regulatory experts, to deliver comprehensive risk assessment tools and ensure compliance with evolving regulatory standards. The ideal candidate will possess a strong understanding of banking risk frameworks, regulatory requirements, and data analytics, with a passion for driving innovation in risk management practices.

Qualifications

The successful candidate should have a bachelor's degree or higher in Finance, Economics, Data Science, or a related field. Proven experience in risk management within the banking or financial services sector is essential, preferably with familiarity in regulatory requirements such as Basel III/IV. Strong analytical skills, proficiency in data analysis tools and programming languages (such as SQL, Python, or R), and experience with risk modeling and quantitative analysis are required. Excellent communication skills, the ability to work collaboratively, and a proactive approach to problem-solving are also important. Knowledge of regulatory reporting standards and experience with risk management software are advantageous.

Responsibilities

As a Risk Management Specialist, your responsibilities will include:

Designing and developing risk measurement models and tools that align with regulatory requirements and industry best practices.
Analyzing large datasets to identify risk patterns and trends, supporting data-driven decision-making processes.
Implementing and maintaining risk control procedures and reporting frameworks for clients.
Collaborating with software developers to ensure the technical robustness and accuracy of risk management solutions.
Providing expert advice and support to clients regarding regulatory compliance and risk mitigation strategies.
Staying updated on industry developments, regulatory changes, and emerging risk management techniques.
Conducting training sessions and workshops to enhance clients' understanding of risk management practices.

Benefits

At S Rating und Risikosysteme GmbH, we value our employees and offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes competitive salary packages, flexible working arrangements, and opportunities for professional development. Our employees have access to ongoing training programs, participation in industry conferences, and collaborative projects that foster growth and innovation. We promote a healthy work-life balance and provide a supportive work environment that encourages diversity and inclusion. Additionally, our company offers health insurance, paid time off, and performance-based incentives to recognize and reward excellence.

Equal Opportunity

We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace that values diversity and equal opportunity. S Rating und Risikosysteme GmbH does not discriminate based on race, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, disability, or any other protected characteristic. We believe that a diverse workforce enhances our ability to innovate and serve our clients effectively. We encourage applications from all qualified candidates who are eager to contribute to our mission of advancing risk management solutions within the financial sector.

jobs.description:
About APTNEXUS

Since our founding 2012, APTNEXUS has empowered federal agencies and commercial enterprises to navigate the complexities of the digital landscape. As a quality-driven small business, we specialize in the seamless delivery of IT modernization and elite cybersecurity solutions. We help our clients modernize and fortify their technology stacks —ensuring their most critical data and assets remain resilient, optimized, and secure in an evolving threat environment.

Clearance

Ability to obtain and maintain a Minimum Background Investigation (MBI) for our Department of Treasury customer. Candidates must reside in, and perform all work from, the continental United States or its outlying territories.

Location:

Remote (United States)

Work Schedule

Full-time, remote. Must be available during core business hours (Eastern Time) to support team meetings and stakeholder working sessions. Occasional travel may be required.

Salary Range

$100,000 to $125,000 annually, commensurate with experience

Position Overview

AptNexus is seeking a Senior Data Analyst (Risk Analytics) to support a cybersecurity compliance program for our Department of Treasury customer. The program uses a risk-based model to prioritize which government partner organizations receive compliance reviews, drawing on historical review findings and other risk indicators. In this role, you will maintain and enhance the risk model and its scoring logic, ensure the accuracy and integrity of the underlying data, and deliver dashboards and analysis that inform customer decision-making. The ideal candidate is a detail-oriented self-starter who combines strong technical skills with the ability to explain results clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

Duties/Responsibilities

Maintain and enhance a risk-based selection model and the scoring calculations that rank partner organizations by compliance risk.
Maintain and operate the data fields, code, and scripts used to analyze review findings and their relationship to risk model outputs.
Revise and maintain the formulas and Excel VBA macros that apply weighted evaluations of risk factors, ensuring correct calculation and functionality.
Aggregate data from multiple sources to identify the highest-risk partner organizations, and validate automated results to ensure the accuracy of rankings.
Design and maintain risk dashboards in Tableau that track findings, risk levels, rankings, remediation status, and historical trends.
Identify opportunities to improve the risk model, and plan and implement approved enhancements in coordination with customer stakeholders.
Present analytical results, model changes, and recommendations to customer leadership and non-technical audiences.
Contribute to quarterly planning sessions and the work plan that defines analytics priorities and deadlines.
Guide and review the work of supporting data analysts.
Document models, data definitions, scripts, and procedures so that work is repeatable and transferable.
Comply with all customer security, privacy, and records management requirements, using only Government-furnished equipment and approved systems.

Required Skills

Minimum of five (5) years of experience in data analysis, analytics, or data science, including building or maintaining analytical or risk scoring models.
Demonstrated experience applying scientific methods, processes, and algorithms to extract insights from structured and unstructured data.
Advanced proficiency in Python 3 and R for data preparation, analysis, and automation.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including complex formulas and developing and maintaining VBA macros.
Proficiency building interactive dashboards and visualizations in Tableau.
Experience with automation and scripting techniques to improve the accuracy and efficiency of recurring analysis.
Demonstrated ability to present analytical results clearly to management and non-technical audiences.
Familiarity with risk-based approaches to compliance or audit, or with cybersecurity compliance data, is preferred.
Detail-oriented self-starter who takes ownership of assignments, manages competing priorities, and drives work to completion with minimal supervision.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex analysis into clear recommendations.
Sound professional judgment and integrity in handling sensitive information.
Must meet federal eligibility requirements for a position of public trust, including U.S. citizenship or lawful permanent residency, federal tax compliance, Selective Service registration (if applicable), a credit check, and fingerprinting.
Must complete customer-required security awareness training upon onboarding and annually thereafter.

Education Requirement

Bachelor’s degree or higher in accounting, mathematics, engineering, finance, economics, data science, or a closely related quantitative discipline from an accredited college or university.

Your Role at Baxter

At Baxter, our mission to save and sustain lives is at the heart of everything we do. In this role, you will lead complex, cross-functional programs that support the delivery, reliability, and lifecycle performance of infusion pump systems used in patient care.

The Senior Program Manager is the core team leader and single point of program accountability for assigned Infusion Systems pump programs. This role translates product, customer, quality, regulatory, and business priorities into integrated execution plans and drives timely decisions across global teams.

You will partner with R&D Engineering, Systems Engineering, Software, Quality, Regulatory, Medical, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Service, Commercial, Finance, and external partners to deliver program commitments in a highly regulated medical device environment.

What You'll Be Doing

Lead complex infusion pump programs across the full product lifecycle, including new product development, software and firmware releases, sustaining engineering, compliance, cost improvement, and product obsolescence initiatives.

Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Life Sciences, Business, or a related field with 10+ years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 8+ years of relevant experience.

Proven experience with electromechanical medical devices, infusion systems, connected products, or other safety-critical technologies.
Strong understanding of medical device development and lifecycle processes, including systems engineering, hardware and software development, verification and validation, design controls, and change management.

Expertise in program planning and execution, including critical path management, financial management, risk mitigation, structured problem solving, and data-driven decision making.
Working knowledge of FDA Quality System Regulations, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, and applicable medical device quality and regulatory standards.
Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence across global matrix organizations; PMP, PgMP, or equivalent certification preferred.

About the Company

Beacon Healthcare Systems Inc. is a SaaS company focused on healthcare compliance and regulatory software. Its solutions support stakeholders across the health insurance industry, including Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial healthcare. Headquartered in Huntington Beach, California, the company operates in a regulated healthcare technology environment.

About the Role

The Business Analyst will bridge business needs and technology solutions within Beacon Healthcare Systems’ healthcare compliance platform. This role works closely with business stakeholders, clients, engineers, and product teams to gather requirements, translate them into actionable technical specifications, and support the evolution of the product.

Reporting to the Director of Implementations, the Business Analyst will play an important role in new product implementations, client deployments, and coordinated releases. The position requires a structured and analytical approach to problem-solving, strong attention to detail, and the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

This is a fully remote position.

Key Responsibilities

•Elicit, analyze, and document business requirements through interviews, workshops, surveys, and process observation.
•Translate business needs into functional specifications, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flow diagrams.
•Maintain a requirements repository and ensure traceability from business needs through delivery and testing.
•Analyze existing business processes, workflows, and systems to identify inefficiencies, gaps, and improvement opportunities.
•Develop as-is and to-be process maps, gap analyses, and business cases to support technology and process change decisions.
•Collaborate with Product and Engineering to ensure solutions are technically feasible, scalable, and aligned with business objectives.
•Serve as the primary liaison between client business stakeholders and Engineering and Product teams throughout the project lifecycle.
•Facilitate requirements review sessions, design walkthroughs, and user acceptance testing with business owners.
•Communicate project progress, requirement changes, and risk implications to relevant stakeholders.
•Support new product implementations by documenting client-specific configuration needs, integration requirements, and deployment considerations.
•Support client deployments, including validation and troubleshooting.
•Participate in release planning and coordination to ensure features are documented, tested, and aligned with client deployment schedules.
•Support QA teams by reviewing test plans and test cases against documented requirements and acceptance criteria.
•Participate in Agile sprint ceremonies, including backlog grooming, sprint planning, and sprint reviews.
•Produce post-implementation reviews and lessons-learned documentation to support continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

•Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field.
•5–10 years of business analysis experience in a SaaS, technology, or healthcare IT environment.
•Proven ability to gather and document complex business requirements and translate them into technical user stories and functional specifications.
•Strong proficiency in business analysis techniques, including process mapping, use case development, and gap analysis.
•Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments.
•Familiarity with tools such as Jira, Confluence, or Azure DevOps.
•Excellent communication and facilitation skills, including the ability to lead workshops and present findings to executive stakeholders.
•Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to deconstruct complex problems and identify root causes.
•Strong written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences.
•Strong attention to accuracy, consistency, and completeness in documentation.
•Ability to build trusted relationships with stakeholders at different levels of an organization.
•Ability to manage workload effectively, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing priorities.

Preferred Qualifications / Requirements

•CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional) or PMI-PBA certification.
•Experience in healthcare, insurance, or regulated software environments.

The compensation range for this remote Business Analyst position is $85,000–$97,000 per year, plus benefits and bonus. The company also offers remote flexibility and a collaborative work environment.

Role Overview

This position entails managing security operations on a shift basis, investigating security events, coordinating incident escalations, and fostering team development within a high-volume security operations center. Key Responsibilities

Cloud Security Platforms: AWS Security Hub, Azure Security Center, GCP Security (Security Command Center)

Taco Bell was born and raised in California and has been around since 1962. We went from selling everyone’s favorite Crunchy Tacos on the West Coast to a global brand with 7,500+ restaurants, 350 franchise organizations, that serve 42+ million fans each week around the globe. We’re not only the largest Mexican-inspired quick service brand (QSR) in the world, we’re also part of the biggest restaurant group in the world: Yum! Brands.

Much of our fan love and authentic connection with our communities are rooted in being rebels with a cause. From ensuring we use high quality, sustainable ingredients to elevating restaurant technology in ways that hasn’t been done before… we will continue to be inclusive, bold, challenge the status quo and push industry boundaries.

We’re a company that celebrates and advocates for different, has bold self-expression, strives for a better future, and brings the fun while we’re at it. We fuel our culture with real people who bring unique experiences. We inspire and enable our teams and the world to Live Más.

At Taco Bell, we’re Cultural Rebels. Want to join in on the passion-fueled fun? Learn more about the career below.

About The Job

The Program Manager, Value & Digital Enterprise is a strategic leadership role within Taco Bell’s Enterprise Operations & Program Management team. This role leads the integrated Value, Digital Integration, and Loyalty portfolios, translating business strategy into coordinated cross-functional plans that deliver current-year commitments while building the future pipeline.

The Program Manager provides senior program leadership across multiple interconnected portfolios, leading through ambiguity, aligning priorities across functions, surfacing risks and trade-offs early, and ensuring leaders have the visibility and recommendations required to make timely decisions. The role partners closely with category and enterprise Team Leads and works across Marketing, Digital & Technology, Product, FIT, Operations, Finance, Insights, and other cross-functional teams to connect strategy, planning, and execution through Taco Bell’s 3Ds Enterprise System.

This role also leads and develops two L8 Associate Program Managers, allocating program-management capacity based on business complexity, risk, and priority while building a high-performing program-management capability. Success requires a leader who can operate at both Speed 1, delivering today’s commitments, and Speed 2, planning and enabling tomorrow’s growth.

The Day-to-Day

Value Portfolio Leadership

Partner with the Value Team Lead to translate Value strategy into an integrated current- and future-year roadmap across testing, national launches, and pipeline development.
Lead program management across the Value portfolio, connecting initiatives through Discover, Design, and Deploy and ensuring cross-functional readiness for key business milestones.
Identify sequencing, resource, timing, and cross-functional dependencies early; develop scenarios and recommended paths when priorities, scope, or capacity conflict.
Provide leadership visibility into portfolio health, critical milestones, decisions, risks, and readiness, ensuring issues are surfaced at the right time and level.

Digital Integration & Loyalty Leadership

Lead integrated planning across Digital Integration and Loyalty, connecting initiatives to the broader Marketing calendar, enterprise priorities, and enabling technology and operational roadmaps.
Align business objectives and cross-functional roadmaps across Marketing, Digital & Technology, Operations, FIT, Finance, Product, and other partners to ensure coordinated delivery.
Anticipate enterprise dependencies and readiness risks that could impact customer experience, launch timing, or business outcomes and establish mitigation plans before issues become execution barriers.
Create clear governance and leadership visibility for complex initiatives requiring sustained cross-functional coordination and decision support.

Strategic Program & Portfolio Leadership

Set the program-management approach, governance, and operating rhythm across the assigned portfolio, ensuring consistency in planning, risk management, escalation, and decision-making.
Recommend sequencing, resource, timeline, and scope trade-offs to Team Leads and senior leadership based on business impact, risk, dependencies, and capacity.
Determine which issues should be resolved within the working team versus escalated to enterprise leadership, bringing forward clear recommendations and decision options.
Use portfolio insights to identify recurring risks, bottlenecks, or capacity constraints and partner with Enterprise Operations and Portfolio Management to improve how the work is planned and governed.

People & Capability Leadership

Lead, coach, and develop two L8 Associate Program Managers, establishing clear ownership, performance expectations, and development priorities.
Allocate program-management capacity across the portfolio based on complexity, risk, business priority, and developmental opportunity.
Review program and portfolio health across direct reports, redirecting resources and escalating trade-offs when capacity or complexity exceeds the support model.
Build strategic program-management capability across the team by strengthening judgment, executive communication, enterprise thinking, risk management, and influence without authority.

Cross-Functional & Executive Partnership

Serve as a strategic thought partner to Value, Digital Integration, and Loyalty leaders, helping translate strategy into executable plans and surfacing decisions needed to maintain momentum.
Lead high-stakes cross-functional discussions where ambiguity, competing priorities, or dependencies require alignment across teams and functions.
Create concise, decision-oriented leadership communications that provide a clear view of portfolio health, risks, trade-offs, and recommended actions.
Champion Taco Bell’s enterprise ways of working and 3Ds disciplines within the portfolio while partnering with Enterprise Operations on broader process and operating-model improvements.

Is this you?

7–10+ years of progressive program/project management, business operations, marketing operations, digital, loyalty, or comparable cross-functional leadership experience.
BA/BS degree or equivalent relevant experience. MBA or advanced degree a plus.
Demonstrated experience leading multiple complex programs or portfolios with significant cross-functional dependencies and executive visibility.
People leadership experience, including coaching, delegation, performance management, and development of program/project management talent.
Strong program-management expertise across integrated planning, risk management, governance, prioritization, issue resolution, and executive communication.
Experience with Monday.com and other portfolio management solutions.

HENSOLDT | Ulm

Ulm

Stellenbeschreibung

Für den Bereich „Cyber Security“ suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen „Cyber Security Program Manager (w/m/d)“ am Standort Ulm (bevorzugt) Fürstenfeldbruck, Taufkirchen, Immenstaad, Oberkochen.

Das erwartet dich bei uns

Der Bereich Cyber Security verantwortet die Weiterentwicklung der unternehmensweiten Cyber-Security-Strategie und den Schutz der IT-Landschaft von HENSOLDT. Im Rahmen eines langfristig angelegten Zero-Trust-Programms werden Sicherheitsarchitekturen und -maßnahmen über mehrere Domänen der Inhouse IT hinweg weiterentwickelt. Der Cyber Security Program Manager koordiniert dabei die übergreifende Ausrichtung des Programms und arbeitet mit rund 50 Beteiligten und Key Usern aus sieben IT-Domänen zusammen.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören

Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung des unternehmensweiten Zero-Trust-Programms über sieben Domänen der Inhouse IT hinweg
Weiterentwicklung der Programm-Roadmap sowie Koordination und Abstimmung der Zero-Trust-Initiativen und Abhängigkeiten zwischen den beteiligten IT-Domänen
Fachliche Bewertung und Einordnung moderner Cyber-Security-Technologien und Sicherheitsmaßnahmen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Endpoint Protection, Netzwerk- und Firewall-Sicherheit sowie Angriffserkennung
Koordination der beteiligten Key User sowie zentraler technischer und fachlicher Stakeholder innerhalb der IT-Organisation
Sicherstellung einer übergreifend abgestimmten Umsetzung der Zero-Trust-Zielsetzung sowie Identifikation und Steuerung von Schnittstellen, Abhängigkeiten und Handlungsbedarfen
Vorbereitung und Moderation von Entscheidungsformaten sowie transparente Kommunikation von Programmfortschritt, Risiken und wesentlichen technischen Fragestellungen

Das bringst du mit

Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich Cyber Security sowie nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der Umsetzung oder Steuerung von Cyber-Security-Projekten
Fundierte Kenntnisse aktueller Cyber-Security-Technologien und Sicherheitsarchitekturen sowie praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einem relevanten Security-Umfeld, beispielsweise Endpoint Protection, Firewall-Sicherheit oder moderner Angriffserkennung
Erfahrung in der Koordination komplexer technischer Vorhaben sowie im Stakeholder Management über unterschiedliche IT-Bereiche hinweg
Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Koordinationsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise in komplexen technischen Umfeldern
Bereitschaft zur Durchführung einer Sicherheitsüberprüfung
Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

jetzt bewerben

Über das Unternehmen

HENSOLDT ist ein führendes europäisches Hightech-Unternehmen der Verteidigungs- und Sicherheitsindustrie mit Sitz in Taufkirchen bei München. Das Unternehmen entwickelt Sensorlösungen, Elektronik und Software für die Bereiche Luft, Land, See, Cyber und Weltraum und unterstützt Streitkräfte weltweit dabei, Bedrohungen frühzeitig zu erkennen und fundierte operative Entscheidungen zu treffen.

Aufbauend auf jahrzehntelanger Erfahrung in missionskritischer Sensorik verbindet HENSOLDT Radar-, Optronik-, Elektronik- und Cyberkompetenzen mit datengetriebener Software und künstlicher Intelligenz.

Ziel ist es, Sensordaten aus unterschiedlichen Plattformen und Domänen zu integrieren, zu analysieren und zu einem verlässlichen Lagebild zu fusionieren.

Im Geschäftsjahr 2025 erzielte HENSOLDT mit rund 9.500 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern einen Umsatz von 2,46 Milliarden Euro. Das Unternehmen ist an der Frankfurter Wertpapierbörse im MDAX notiert.

Vos responsabilités en tant que Project Manager Officer - Engineering:

Superviser la planification, l'exécution et le suivi des projets afin d'assurer l'atteinte des objectifs fixés dans le respect des délais, des coûts et de la qualité attendue.
Encadrer, accompagner et motiver une équipe de chefs de projet en favorisant la collaboration, le développement des compétences et l'amélioration continue.
Analyser les processus existants et proposer des actions d'amélioration, tout en mettant en œuvre les retours d'expérience nécessaires à l'évolution des standards.

Définir et déployer des indicateurs de performance (KPI) permettant de mesurer efficacement l'efficacité des projets et celle des équipes.
Identifier et évaluer les risques liés aux projets puis élaborer et suivre les plans d'actions nécessaires à leur maîtrise.
Assurer une communication fluide et transparente entre les équipes projets, les opérations et la Direction afin de garantir une bonne circulation de l'information.
Favoriser un climat collaboratif entre toutes les disciplines techniques impliquées (électrique, mécanique, automation, génie civil) pour maximiser la réussite collective.

Le profil idéal que nous recherchons:

Diplôme d'Ingénieur industriel ou civil avec orientation chimie ou procédés ou équivalent reconnu par le secteur.
Expérience confirmée d'au moins 7 ans en tant que PMO ou dans une fonction similaire avec une solide expérience en management d'équipe, coaching et développement des talents.
Certification en gestion de projet (PMP, PRINCE2, Agile ou équivalent) indispensable; une certification Green Belt ou Black Belt Lean Six Sigma constitue un atout supplémentaire appréciable.
Excellent niveau de français et de l'anglais (lu, écrit, parlé).

Notre client est un chef de file renommé de l'industrie, connu pour son engagement envers l'innovation, la qualité et l'excellence.
Ils offrent un environnement de travail dynamique qui favorise la créativité et encourage l'épanouissement professionnel.
L'accent mis sur l'amélioration continue et les progrès technologiques les distingue de leurs concurrents.

Si vous vous considérez comme un spécialiste flexible de la résolution de problèmes avec votre sens analytique, doté de solides compétences d'amélioration et d'innovation, et prêt à faire face à des conditions difficiles, le poste du Project Manager Engineering est fait pour vous.
